Completed Interaction 01: typed identity/compiler/membership foundation.

Acceptance audit
1. Explicit entity keys survive reorder/filter, non-finite geometry omission, independent row types and facets. EntityIndex rejects duplicate keys; KeySpace reference witnesses isolate namespaces. Repeated heterogeneous category link keys are allowed and deduplicated.
2. Point batches retain one routing wrapper and indexed TargetSeries; a 10,000-point fixture verifies shape and released source rows under lean retention. Multi-primitive summary marks and custom geometry parts retain one logical target. Composition tests verify ordinary row/column/grid/inset scene and device routing and reject duplicate plan IDs/context mismatch.
3. Count-only, representative, partial, exact and deferred membership are checked capabilities; exactKeys rejects inadequate retention and stale DataRevision. No claim of implemented aggregate selection is made.
4. Typed controller subscriptions (in child 2's optional module) preserve EntityKey[Int] and LinkKey[String] through compilation and activation; a compile-time fixture rejects EventRecord[String] subscribers for an Int controller. Source member keys are extracted explicitly rather than inferred from row equality. New custom-stat tests cover all rows comparing equal and rejection of a key mutated after source-index validation. Codecs reject non-canonical payloads and incompatible namespace/schema/version.
5. Ordinary plotting signatures are retained. New independent packaging uses a distinct method rather than an overload that would affect existing contextual inference. Interaction compilation requires the ordinary Plot and explicit bindings; arbitrary metadata-poor scenes cannot be rebound as typed plans. Full compatibility gate passed as detailed below, alongside renderer conformance and public-source examples.

Verification
- sbt coreJVM/testOnly intaglio.interaction.* and coreJS/testOnly intaglio.interaction.*: 42 tests pass per platform (includes two new adversarial custom-stat tests).
- sbt docs/mdoc: 49 documentation files compile, zero errors.
- Previous unchanged runtime sources: 20 JVM and 20 Scala.js tests pass, including typed subscription and README workflow; logs and source hashes retained.
- Existing static conformance: module boundary 6; SVG JVM 2; SVG Scala.js 2; Canvas 2; Java2D 2; JavaFX 2 passed. These are renderer-contract tests, not browser/native input proof.
- tools/check-compatibility.sh exited 0. It built pinned baseline 2ab52e819537faf30c1f63116c4705dbb4aeab53 / 0.2.0 and checked the working tree as 0.2.1-SNAPSHOT. Dependency/backward checks and all eleven TASTy module checks passed. The full gate calibrated real class-file negative fixtures and validated all 79 exact reviewed forward-only additions. No backward or TASTy suppression was added; no baseline/intention change. The reviewed source approximation and its limits are documented in docs/compatibility.md.
- Effective filter scope was verified after correcting cross-project setting placement to core.jvmSettings; earlier failed attempts and their logs remain recorded. Calibration proves removed legacy methods and unreviewed class/method additions still report. The public-source examples and type tests are separate evidence; no universal Scala source-compatibility claim.
- Local Scala 3.3.8 / Homebrew Java 25.0.1. Supported JDK 17/21 and Scala 3.9 matrix have not been run; no hosted CI or published/external-consumer proof.

Scope boundaries
This closes only the compiler/identity foundation. Child 2 still needs complete presentation/gesture contracts. Picking, browser SVG/Canvas widgets, linked-view coordination, standalone export, exact aggregates, selection algebra/history, measured performance and JavaFX interaction remain outstanding in the active twelve-child epic. No widget or feature-baseline completion is implied.
